body: We need to notify the client when a primary has changed so that they won't keep sending messages to the old one.

comments.body: Done in 06ba5de: every reply carries the view number, Client::on_reply adopts it, and the next request goes to the new view's primary. A request already in flight when the primary died reaches the new one anyway, because since bbcc14d a client re-sends an unanswered request to every replica and backups ignore it.

title: Notify client if primary changed
